# Reading Novels Project Guidance

- This is a Flutter/Dart web app targeting GitHub Pages, with an optional Windows desktop target.
- Keep the library, book details, and reading appearance controls responsive across narrow and desktop layouts.
- Google authentication and Drive access require OAuth configuration and end-to-end testing before being presented as live features.
- Never commit OAuth credentials or access tokens.
- Keep the web and Windows targets; Android is not a project target.
- After Flutter is available, run `flutter pub get`, `flutter analyze`, and `flutter test`.
